engine.notes: Tampa Bay's training scene has thinned: The Box Theater's domain (boximprov.com) now serves a gambling site, American Stage dropped its improv program, and the Tampa Improv became the Tampa Funny Bone, a stand-up room, in December 2023. Spitfire in St. Pete is the only improv theater with a class series, and its core curriculum is paused until 2027.

entries.name: Spitfire Comedy House
entries.summary: St. Pete's comedy theater since 2016, with improv, sketch and stand-up shows Wednesday to Saturday, a weekly $20 drop-in improv class and a core class series that returns in 2027.
entries.schedule: Shows Wed-Sat; Whose Line Uncensored Saturdays 7:30 pm; drop-in class Sundays 2-4 pm, $20
signals: Whose Line Uncensored in its ninth year
entries.reasons: A real theater with a packed weekly lineup and a decade behind it, marked down because the levelled class series is on hold until 2027 and only drop-ins and short workshops run this season.

entries.name: Nine and Numb Improv Troupe
entries.summary: Community-theater improv troupe resident at Carrollwood Players since 2005, playing short-form Friday shows with a late adults-only set and a Friday-night open mic.
entries.schedule: Fridays 9 pm and adults-only 11 pm, $10; Friday open mic 7:30-8:30 pm from January
signals: Resident at Carrollwood Players, 4333 Gunn Hwy
entries.reasons: Two decades in a permanent community theater and a dated season earn the longevity points, but there are no classes and only one night a week of shows.
